verdicts.reason: A keeps the original three-part left/centre/right structure and holds text at a readable size. However, the stained-glass window runs almost the full canvas height, with nearly no top or bottom margin, so the middle feels cramped. B gives the window better breathing room, but it shrinks both the headline and the date/address block too far. The fine print is barely legible at banner size, and the elements float in a lot of empty white space, which weakens the hierarchy.
